notes.title: Virtual Reality Girls on Steam.
notes.notes:
Virtual Reality Girls was temporarily removed from the store as a result of a complaints that were sent to Valve about the game. 

We currently are working to change the stuff that might have offended some people. The game will be back on Steam when we resolve all the problems.
Those who already bought the game still own it and are able to play.
